description: Check a product catalogue against EU Safety Gate alerts: exact GTIN/EAN barcode match, marketplace listing id (e.g. Amazon ASIN) match, and brand + model fuzzy match, over the last N weekly reports. Returns only products that matched, with match type, score and the alert. Use for marketplace / retailer compliance screening.

name.description: Product name (used with brand when no model)

weeks.description: Weekly reports to scan (1 request each, cached)

name: eu_safety_gate_match
